20037.long_desc: The ultimate space saving machine that brings all your pinball and arcade favorites to you! The Arcooda Dynasty Vertical Pinball Machine features a massive 32 Inch Touch Screen Playfield, 19 Inch LCD Monitor for the backglass and an 8.8 Inch LCD DMD to simulate that traditional pinball feel. It also includes joysticks and buttons for two players, adding in the classic arcade feel to make this machine an all-in-one solution. The Arcooda Dynasty Vertical Pinball Machine is VR compatible, bringing a whole new level to video pinball gaming. By using plug and play features, players can simply plug in their VR headsets and play all their favorite VR games (including pinball!). What makes Dynasty Vertical Pinball Machine so great and versatile is that you can keep updating your machine with free firmware updates (to update to current consoles/hardware if supported) as well as adding various add-ons and panel changes. This is a dynamic machine, it will be as “fresh” and modern as the day you purchased. MONITOR #1: 32 Inch Vertical Touch Screen Monitor (16:9)supports 15khz, 31khz, and up to 1080P HD inputs via VGA and HDMI inputs. This monitor has been designed for Pinball Gamers featuring 1.3ms response time at 1080P. Monitor adjustments are at the front of the machine for easy handling. MONITOR #2: 19 Inch Horizontal Backglass Monitor (16:10) supports 1980x1440, inputs via VGA and HDMI inputs. This monitor has been designed for Pinball Gamers featuring 1.3ms response time at 1080P. Monitor adjustments are at the front of the machine for easy handling. MONITOR #3: 8.8 Inch DMD Backglass Monitor (4:1) supports up to 1920x480, inputs via mini HDMI input. This monitor has been designed for Pinball Gamers featuring 1.3ms response time at 1080P. Monitor adjustments are at the front of the machine for easy handling. SOUND: with 2.1 audio sound system, this custom sound package was designed for arcade, including subwoofer. Adjust the sound via volume control and separate subwoofer volume control. CONTROLS: Dynasty Vertical Pinball Machine features Japanese made joystick and buttons. Sanwa are the world's premium arcade controllers offering years of trouble free operation. CABINET: Up to 2mm powdercoated steel construction, with acrylic panels. Internally, the machine is layered allowing you to update your machine at any time with the Arcooda Game Wizard add-on, or add your own internal functions. With industry standard wheels and screw down feet, Dynasty Vertical Pinball Machine also includes 6 input power board, 3.3V 12A , 5V 20A, 12V 9A power supply, separate 12V power supply, 2x 12volt fans, and EMI filter. STORAGE: The Dynasty Vertical Pinball Machine features 2 deep storage drawers for storing peripherals and spare parts. store your keyboard, mouse, hand controllers, light gun controller or vr headset safely inside the cabinet when not in use. WIRING: The cabinet is designed with Jamma wiring system. The machine also supports JVS wiring system (optional) and Game Wizard (optional). CONTROL PANEL: comes as standard arcade 2 player, 8 buttons per side. However the panel is upgradeable, where you can remove metal holders and make this as a 6 button per player control panel, an 8 button single player control panel, 6 button single player control panel LIGHTING: programmable 12volt LED lighting circuit controlled via bluetooth phone app, remote control or internal controller. Choose the colour of light, brightness, or pattern. There are 2 lighting circuits - one for the control panel, the other for the cabinet body, turn one off, both off, with different patterns, or same pattern. - ARCOODA REAR MULTIMEDIA ADD-ON: turn your cabinet into a media centre, with HDMI, USB and RJ45 input/output function. Connect your cabinet to your gaming hub, stream your gameplay on secondary monitors and much more. - CUSTOM ARTWORK: add your own designs to the Monitor frame, Side art and front door art. Full flexibility is available to you. Play with friends around the world, record your sessions and stream with full media support for Youtube, Twitch, Discord, Skype and more. Firmware updates are constantly being released to support the latest consoles and software and drive enhanced performance. Register your Arcooda machine online to join the owner's community for benefits such as set up videos, firmware updates, special downloads, exclusive discounts, technical support and the owners forum. Please Note: This is a standup arcade machine. Disclaimer: All product and company names are trademarks or registered trademarks of their respective holders.
